counter_evidence_review.review_notes: The negative reading is a name/content mismatch: a repo titled 'MultiAgent-template' with a 23-byte README whose visible activity is a NASDAQ data-fetch loop with a 1.3 MB sqlite database committed to git. Under the fairness rules this is undocumented and repurposed rather than deceptive — there are zero claims to be unbacked. Confidence in any stronger negative label is limited by the unviewable .claude/ and docs/ directories.

evidence_conflicts: Repo name and README title say 'Multi-Agent Template'; the visible root files, workflows and 76/100 bot commits are a NASDAQ market-data fetch pipeline — the repo appears repurposed from its bootstrap.

notes: A repo whose name promises a multi-agent template but whose visible life is a twice-weekly NASDAQ data-fetch automation: flat fetch scripts at root, a 1.29 MB checked-in sqlite db, and 76 of the last 100 commits from the data bot. The README is a bare title, so nothing is claimed, documented, or reproducible.
